name: NWWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's own top title from its first card, held eight times across fourteen changes before its own captured record runs out.

name: NWWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: The federation's own secondary singles title through its first year, superseded by a renamed United States Championship per the federation's own later description.

name: NWWF United States Championship (1997)
epitaph: A short-lived singles title retired less than three months after it was first awarded.

name: NWWF United States Championship
epitaph: The federation's own current secondary singles title, described on its own title page as the Intercontinental Championship's successor; no title change survives in any captured document.

name: NWWF Television/Internet Championship
epitaph: A third singles title contested through the federation's own first year, absent from its own later title-belt page.

name: NWWF Global Championship
epitaph: A fourth singles title that changed hands twice, sat retired for four months, then returned for one further reign.

name: NWWF Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: A weight-limited singles title contested for two months in early 1998 before its own record shows it retired.

name: NWWF 3-Man Tag Team Championship
epitaph: A three-man tag title contested for less than a year before its own record shows it retired.

name: NWWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The federation's own standing tag team title, still listed on its own current title-belt page; the current holder is not attested in any captured document.

name: NWWF Hardcore Championship
epitaph: A no-disqualification, pin-anywhere title the federation's own title-belt page calls new to the promotion; no reign survives in any captured document.
